product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone photos of properties into measured 3D models, designs, and estimates for construction professionals, insurers, and homeowners.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog indexes contain product, design, and industry content, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how Hover is built.

public_docs.notes: Public help center contains multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page lists five roles, none with a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. An older Computer Vision posting explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications; Wellfound still displays that title, so third-party listings conflict with the official board.

model_provider.value: Stable Diffusion, Realistic Vision, Metric3D, OneFormer, MLSD, and NormalBAE, combined with Hover’s custom generative AI technology.

compliance_certs.notes: Reviewed legal pages do not claim a completed certification among the five specified; GDPR contractual provisions are not a certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook records a completed debt financing on 2026-02-19; this is financing, not a new equity series.

raised_18mo.notes: The dated financing history records completed debt financing on 2026-02-19, inside the requested window; evidence is a financing database rather than an announcement or filing.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Investor job board lists a Sales Development Representative opening posted 2026-09-29; the official careers page does not display this title.

launched_6mo.notes: The explicitly dated Summer 2026 release collection includes a materially expanded Virtual Walkthrough with irregular-area measurement and scan replay; an exact launch day is not published.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sam Young announced joining Hover as VP of Operations on 2026-03-02.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Hiring signals, not confirmed deployments: the SDR posting requests Salesforce or equivalent CRM experience and familiarity with Outreach, Clay, Gong, or similar prospecting tools.
